questions.question: When five kings fled from Joshua and the Israelites, where did they hide?
After five fleeing kings were found hiding in a cave, what did Joshua tell his men to do to it?

answers.text: Roll large stones against its mouth
Dig a trench around its entrance
Light a fire at its entrance

questions.question: When Joshua had his army commanders put their feet on the necks of five kings, what reason did he give for not being afraid?

answers.text: The LORD will do this to all the enemies they fight
The other kings have already given up
Their army is bigger than any in the land

questions.question: Joshua captured the southern kings and their land in one campaign. Why was he able to do it?

answers.text: The kings had no city walls
